reviews.text: I started playing around 23:30, did a first run where I was pretty lost. In the end of this run I felt more confident, so I start my second run. Floor 20, 450k Gold, 50k dmg per Attack, 4 Attacks at once, all enemies are hit in the first round. Zeus dodges my attack and stuns me, he procceds to annihilate me. Okay, happens was a nice run and I can just play another round, since it can not be that late. It is 3:30... How can that be, I swear I just checked the clock half an hour ago. Where did my time go??? Even if you might be confused at first, if you like Roguelike this game will hook you pretty quick. Enjoy this well made game, but be aware times move faster than normally ~Xaser

This is one of those games that requires the Neutral recommendation. This isn't a bad game, but it is a far cry from the original demo, which was FANTASTIC. The release doesn't compare to the original demo. This has no progression system, [strike]no achievements[/strike], no unlockables, the difficulty is kinda all over the place, characters had their special abilities removed and moved onto item sets and there's no real end. It just goes on for ever and ever. And there are WAY too many items and item sets. Rolling for gear is a major pain in the ass. Especially with the limited inventory space and shop space. Oh and Jupiter's suck and should be removed. Edit: Achievements have been since added.

确实不是roguelite，刚开始玩是有新鲜感的，但是玩了两个小时之后发现就是一直按空格了，引导也是一点也没有，上来那个训练模式是干啥的我也不知道，教程也一点没有，局内数值很多，看起来还不错，但是玩到中盘之后出现的装备强度差太多了，商店还会刷低级装备，你给个升级商店的选项也可以啊，纯Roll一个个的没有名字显示我还要鼠标移上去一个个看数值，玩起来好累。 这款游戏标签里的库存管理有吗？有的，就是收破烂，低级装备升级2合1，然后给你固定数量的背包栏位，完全没有看到有趣的点。 迷宫探索有吗？有的，就是他自动给你分配怪，上面挂个倒计层数的UI，完全没有自由度，我不知道我在探索什么东西，我也不知道我为啥要探索，完全没有局外成长。 角色扮演有吗？我不好说，每个角色其实就是开局数值不一样，可以参考土豆兄弟的角色，其他的除了头像一点差别也没有，勉强可以算是角色扮演。 游戏内容又少又空。游戏内那数值跳的也没有爽感，我不知道我是怎么打赢的，我也不知道我是怎么死的，我只知道我按了空格就会有一大堆东西在屏幕上飘，不是怪死就是我死。 我说句实话，现在就算做成挂机游戏违和感也不会很重。第一次关游戏之后我也没有任何再次打开的想法。 我玩的时候其实还有很奇怪的一点，很多装备都有+爆伤的词条，动辄100 200%，但是+暴击率的词条我一个都没看到，是真的没有暴击率装备还是只有特定的角色才能玩暴击？这有点太蠢了。

看上去是有点策略的背包管理肉鸽，玩起来却完全不是那么回事。天赋树选择很不明确，角色与流派间的差距也很大。而限定最多4个的套装数和多动也塞在套装里，又让装备搭配没有爽感，反而是在合成里疲于奔命。而大多数情况下都要一对多的主角机体性能却完全不如对面，真是幽默中的幽默。在游戏中盘开始就会出现大量的次数盾，而荒谬的是看上去像是这种情况的解决方案的异常状态，几乎对这种场面毫无作用，因为打不中，所以挂不上。单纯堆积数目的次数盾和精英怪在闪避时晕眩角色的联合作用堪称灾难，我甚至很难想象除了印记（对抗反制闪避是晕眩的狗种一号），多击，黄金，万能（对抗60层以后必中的狗种二号）以外的面对高层数以外的方式。设计者也完全不去思考套装的作用究竟是什么，大量消耗法力的套装配上法师英雄那搞笑的蓝量和没有多击魔法的事实，成功的让本来或许有趣的地城冒险变成了一场毫无平衡的灾难。

按我的理解，这种rogue游戏应该是套装来决定深度，而不是靠不停堆叠装备的品质去提升强度。 套装限制这个东西真的是让人体验感很差劲。

1、玩魔法攻击的，但凡有一个怪放出了魔法盾，这把就g了 2、玩闪避反击的，但凡出三个反击前排，这把g（不打也会被自身的闪避反击输出，然后被怪反击直接被秒） 3、玩盾乌龟流，但凡被一个怪一击破盾，直接g 这些人物一局我都玩了1-2个小时了，然后被这些怪直接秒。不碰到克星，就能多爬几层，碰到克星，半小时结束。 后续：又玩了20小时，找到了些解决办法 1、这个问题是我最开始遇到的，那时候还没玩到恶魔套装，只要出了恶魔套就行了，不会给怪放技能的机会 2、出乌龟套就好，只需要一个乌龟装备，第一回合不受伤，第二回合反击怪就不会反击了 3、怕被秒只能多堆点血+攻击+侵彻，这个属性最好的装备是30层后出的武器，多吸收点这把武器就行 目前还没到60层，等我到了60层再看看。 更新， 1、20层前需要吸收100以上的精准； 2、30-60层，多吸收高级的加力量头盔（400多力量）、高级的加物理攻击等头盔（225物理攻击），少量多余得30层武器，少量高级的加信念的戒指 3、攻击、力量、物理攻击，尽量吸收高级的，信念，侵彻（这个我还不知道需要多少，我准备吸到1100以上），这几个属性会比较重要，至于炫裂，60层后，带新武器和配套的戒指，新套装无视怪物的闪避，60层的闪避怪也是可以直接秒的，我从1-95层，基本都是恶魔套装一路秒上去的，所以我个人认为炫裂有一点即可，不需要太多。 目前最高到95层了，死在了22T盾的怪上，完全打不动盾，然后被秒了，下次多堆点侵彻看看，后面的怪的强硬都在1100以上，我的侵彻才500，可能是侵彻不够。 我95层是 乌龟套+恶魔套+传承套（60层的武器+戒指），人物是希德，佣兵套装那个。

However overtime what we see is that rather than fixing, the Dev nerfs all the things that work to the point that as of me writing this review there is a only one viable playing character and only one viable combination of items that will get you to the end game but even then you can't progress too much because the bonus from one set was nerfed to have 50% of it's power. It is a classic case of the Dev not listening at all to the community. He pretends to listen by saying he hears out the people in discord but not only discord isn't the main place for leaving feedback, he only half listens to the feedback of the changes he did (the half listen is he listens to the fanboys who care not for the state of the game because they aren't able to understand balance), paired with the mentality of Devs vs Players. I've tried to stir the game in a good way by providing constructive criticism but again, the dev does not listen and went so far as saying that he will continue with this direction no matter what anyone says. Don't buy if you are thinking about it. Refund it if you are still in time and if like me and many others you can no longer refund. Abandon all hope unless someone makes a mod that solves all balancing issues. EDIT: It is one of those Devs. Not only doesn't accepts constructive feedback telling him what is wrong with the game and possible ways to fix it but actively deletes posts and bans people if they dare to actively speak against his idea of balance which has actively been destroying the game and making people mass quit the game. Save your money and avoid at all costs, this developer does not deserve your hard earned money. For me, anything by this Developer is in active embargo.

This is and will be the most disappointing purchase in my entire life. Firstly, the demo is a lot different than the actual game and more fun. Reasons for my disappointment, bought this game in full right after a full patch nerf, before a 20% off deal, and right before another major patch nerf. Game play is nice, but with the constant nerfs and unusable or buggy set(arcanum) ruins the fun. Especially when those few viable sets get nerfed. The scaling for this game is horrendous(starting around wave 30ish), with each enemy being able to kill you a dozen times over. With your only strat being to have some sort of invincibility(1-2 sets) and try to attack as many times as possible(for maximum dmg) within 2 turns or die. This was fun for the first few hours, but after all these nerfs the game has lost its charm and don't recommend you buy it.

-Bought the game 2 weeks before 1.0.9 -Played it for about 120 hours -Learning the game, runs lasted from around floors 20-80. Discovering items, experimenting with builds I thought would be fun -Update 1.0.9 is live -Silver set, which gives you the "cleanse" ability for the first two rounds (the description of cleanse is literally "Removes all debuffs"), does not remove stun (the most common debuff in the game) -Recently discover it is in fact, NOT a bug, but intended as stated by the dev -Nerfs multiple sets, gold system -New enemy that can't be hit by physical attacks unless its value is more than 2x its max hp -No prominent buffs in other sets that make them viable -For a "roguelike strategy" game, it does not offer a lot of variety in strategy, nor does it give a clear end goal for a run in the first place. -From what I've seen, most players don't make it further than floor 30. However, there are very few that can make it to floor 100 and higher. The problem is that they spend a lot of time calculating, min-maxing and exploiting game mechanics to their advantage. I'm not gonna do all that extra work for a video game. Especially not one with a dev that doesn't listen to the majority of their playerbase and instead caters to making the game harder for the very small minority of players that can make it to the higher floors.

game play loop at its core, buy loot, combine it, combine sets while following constraints and watch the enemys melt. cool sets and easy to understand with a albeit small, a bit of mastery, a really cool item description effect where if you hover an items effect or sub effect it brings up a box showing effects, it works like a wiki's hyperlinks that makes the game super intuitive (GREAT CONCEPT TRUST ME) the bad - the items/charicters are is lagit 60% half thought out half baked ideas, example: the unchained set has - no armour pieces -no accessory's - and only one item out of over 100 meaning that there is a class that doesn't have any way to build or get stronger. being new you might think "whats the issue with that?" and thats a great thought. the issue is that lack of planning and thorough playtesting (it is a small studio i know) resaults in things being WILDLY op or so weak they can conceivably NEVER be purchased or used or dissolved into stats, random lvl 1 emery's that counter a floor 100 build by virtue of "im 100% invincible to 1 of only 2 types of damage" and i dont mean you do a small amount of damage i mean as of this patch 1/3 of the characters are UNPLAYABLE as in "it dosent matter if they have well crafted perks and/or interesting power budgets. no, a random enemy that you can do BILLIONS(or a few trillion) more damage than it has health can **NEVER** die soft locking your run you spent hours on" the games math used to not math out at all but that is fixed now. its buggy , it crashes (but dosent delete much progress when it dose) another example was earlyer the "spiky guy" you would fight would 1 shot you if you used attack instead of magic damage so a VERY COMMON lvl 1 ememy would 1 shot 50% of the player characters (they did fix that and now theres only enemys that are immune to magic damage now). on top of that there is "goblin theiv enemys" that steal % gold from you and run away (not a half bad mechanic! its even in slay the spire ) the issue is in StS you get a chance to win agains them. in mega loot , there is some times just 6 goblin thieves on flor 4 and you can only kill 1 (ie: you lose 20% gold x 5 times) with zero one slips by, say bye bye to MILLIONS OR TEN MILLIONS OF GOLD. the ugly - this change is hard to articulate, however ill try my hardest. there *USED* to be a mechanic where if you were in trouble you [url=https://store.steampowered.com/curator/38888018-United-Critics/]Please follow [b]United Critics[/b] for quality reviews[/url] [h2]Megaloot Review[/h2] [h1]Never Played a Roguelike Like This[/h1] Megaloot is the kind of game that takes the phrase “one man’s trash is another man’s treasure” to a whole new level. It’s an inventory management roguelike RPG that thrives on the thrill of picking up loot, deciding what to keep, what to scrap, and what to literally consume in battle for that sweet, sweet temporary boost. It’s addictive, challenging, and endlessly replayable—just be ready to give your inner hoarder a workout. This game has left Early Access and is now a full-fledged loot bonanza, with co-op multiplayer, hundreds of unique items, and a focus on strategy that’ll keep you coming back for more (or rage-quitting, depending on your floor-clearing skills). [h1]About This Game [/h1] [h2]Storyline [/h2] You’re dropped into a world with a mysterious tower that pulls in stuff from other dimensions—everything from armor and weapons to some rather nasty monsters. Why are you here? Who knows. Why is the tower doing this? Don’t overthink it. The setup is minimal, but it gives you enough context to dive in and start smashing baddies (Get your mind out of the gutter!). If you’re into environmental storytelling, there are breadcrumbs of lore scattered around, teasing deeper themes of ambition and the cost of power. But let’s be real—you’re here for the loot. [h2]Gameplay Mechanics [/h2] This is where Megaloot shines. Every run starts from scratch, forcing you to rely on your loot to shape your build. Loot isn’t just gear—it’s your lifeline, your power source, and sometimes your hail Mary in a tough fight. You can equip items to boost your stats, consume them for temporary effects, or dismantle them for permanent upgrades. It’s a constant balancing act of short-term gains versus long-term power. The game boasts over 150 unique items and 27+ stats to tinker with. Toxicity? Strength? Faith? Sure, why not! The sheer variety means there’s always a new build to experiment with, and the synergy between items makes theorycrafting a blast. The combat itself is snappy and challenging, requiring both quick reflexes and strategic planning—especially in the later floors, where enemies get downright brutal. Multiplayer adds another layer of chaos (in the best way). Playing with friends is equal parts fun and frustrating as you fight over loot, coordinate builds, and celebrate—or commiserate—over your progress. Solo players, don’t worry; the experience is just as rewarding with well-balanced difficulty and smart design that keeps you on your toes. [h2]Visuals & Audio[/h2] Megaloot’s visuals hit that sweet spot between vibrant and gritty. The tower’s various floors are beautifully designed, but they do start to feel repetitive after a while. Still, the flashy particle effects during battles and the satisfying sparkle of a rare item drop make up for the lack of environmental variety. The soundtrack slaps. It ramps up during battles and mellows out when you’re exploring, perfectly matching the game’s pacing. Every sound effect, from the clang of a weapon to the chime of loot, is crisp and satisfying, adding to the immersive feel. [h1]Pros[/h1] [list][*] Deeply satisfying loot and build mechanics with endless possibilities [*] Addictive gameplay loop with high replayability [*] Fun co-op mode that lets you strategize (and argue) with friends [*] Polished visuals and an engaging soundtrack [*] Strategic depth that rewards planning and experimentation[/list] [h1]Cons[/h1] [list][*] Lack of biome variety can make longer sessions feel repetitive [*] Story and lore are subtle to the point of being easy to miss [*] Difficulty spikes can feel punishing, especially for new players [*] Recent updates reportedly toned down gear impact, which might frustrate veterans[/list] [h1]Conclusion[/h1] Megaloot is a love letter to loot junkies, RPG fans, and anyone who loves juggling stats and strategies while mowing down hordes of enemies. It nails that “just one more run” feeling, with a gameplay loop that’s equal parts challenging and rewarding. The co-op multiplayer is a standout feature, making it a great choice for groups of friends, but it’s equally fun solo if you prefer to tackle the tower on your own. Sure, it has a few rough edges—like the repetitive environments and the occasional imbalance—but the sheer depth of its loot system and the fun of crafting unique builds more than make up for it. If the developers keep adding content, this could easily become a genre classic. So, if you’re ready to embrace your inner loot goblin and face the madness of the tower, give Megaloot a shot. It’s chaotic, it’s challenging, and it’s an absolute blast. I'm on the side of 'the update ruined it' The old game was an unpolished, janky, busted mess, but it was fun to see how you could bend the game's reality over your knee and make your computer chug as it tried to figure out ~20 attacks that required scientific notation to be readable while calculating the 4 different status effects you were applying. You weren't going to sink hundreds of hours into this without some sever autism, but it was a good time. The patch wiped away the jank, and the mess of it all, but it also wiped away the fun. I played about 60 hours into the old version of the game and had a fun time with it. On the new versionI found myself wanting to do just about anything else inside of a half hour. It took me multiple sessions to finish one run, and I only made it to like level 20 because I just was bored.

I've played this game since Demo and Prelude and was lured into it by the unique mechanics of the "absorbing shop items" and the removed-and-now-being-reintroduced Dismantle feature. I tried playing this again today to re-live that since I've been re-watching some videos and was curious as to how the game is like right now (e.g. new items, sets, added features, etc). I was a bit shocked that the entire game I spent an odd 20 hours on is now so much different to what I paid for. I would imagine an early-access game would get away with complete gameplay overhauls, but for a fully-released game to do this every so often is so disappointing. What's even more disappointing is how the dev reacts to people calling them out on it. Just imagine buying a blue t-shirt, leaving it in your closet for a few months after you enjoyed wearing it for a few weeks. Fast forward to checking up on that blue t-shirt since you wanted to try putting on that look again, only to find out that your blue t-shirt is now a polka-dot micro-bikini with a tag that says "blue t-shirt" on it. Bottom line, I PAID FOR A BLUE T-SHIRT and I WANT A BLUE T-SHIRT.

[h1] 做一些攻略，一些重要的游戏机制 [/h1] 1，拆解功能：拆解一件装备，永久获得其属性，在10、25、50、75楼层最后 2，装备有附魔属性，拖拽到底下分裂提取，但这个材料只能和原先的同名装备合成 3，[b] 商人是重点玩法！ [/b]提取的附魔属性，送给商人，下次遇到商人会返还你附魔材料，可以和任意装备绑定 4，装备稀有度最高是神圣，2个神圣合成可以产出附魔属性，甚至在原有属性上增加乘区，是后期提高面板的重要方法 5，套组专精：角色血条下有个100%的专精值(可以通过附魔提高，上限175%) 每拥有(穿戴)一种套组的装备，会占用一定的专精值，比如探子套组占25%，猎人套组占10% 6，套组协同机制：比如探子套组+暗影套组=前锋套组，[u] 注意这里只是前锋套组覆盖了原先的探子套组 [/u] 前锋套组的计数=探子+暗影，所以只需要1件探子+1件暗影，就可以凑出满效果的前锋，但是暗影的满效果还是需要单独凑3件 7，阿蒙角色武器会占2个槽位，所以一个武器会=2个套组计数，带一个暗影武器和一个暗影斗篷就可以凑出暗影套组效果3 [h1] 恶心机制怪应对方法： [/h1] [h3] 完美奴隶：逆天无敌哥 [/h3] 我必须吐槽一下这个逆天机制怪，6段攻击次数，攻击力极高，80层左右开始会带3层无敌和3层祝福（不吃减益） 如果敌人中有风之守护者，所有敌人会翻倍攻击次数，就是12段攻击次数，我感觉很多套路都难以抵抗3回合的12段攻击 应对方法： 1，头盔 帝王意志（4层以上出）被动效果是偷取攻击目标的增益 但是这个头盔带黄金、奥秘2个套组效果，占45%专精，需要规划好装备的搭配（就是备2套，遇到无敌哥切换装备） 最好是通过其他装备的附魔获得这个头盔的被动，戒指出现的概率比较高（感觉） 2，王者之剑（60层以上出）被动效果是移除攻击目标的增益（但是这剑很贵，而且出现概率低） 3，其他龟壳流派.... [h3] 木星：闪避哥 [/h3] 后期闪避值很高，闪了让你晕一次，对脆皮威胁很高 1，最佳应对是猎人套组3的效果，暴击伤害无法被闪避 2，杰斯被动，拥有无敌期间免疫眩晕和减速 3，只带猎人戒指，命中暴击后+25%命中，可以先攻击其他怪堆起来一些命中，需要你有一定暴击率 4，招架可以将眩晕反弹 5，闪避一次-25%闪避，discord上大佬说是提高攻击次数和用恶意、余烬、扩散（恶魔斧被动的群攻）等伤害来减少它的闪避[spoiler] 没逐一测试，我感觉还是不靠谱 [/spoiler]

Game gets a lot of hate ever since design updates were made. I do agree the original was really good and that ignoring players who love the game may not be the best design decisions as you see mixed reviews and clear off-putting comments. I also put it down for awhile myself. Picking it back up again, I was able to make it to level 100+ with Tyr in the current state of the game after forgetting how to play because of all of the changes (0.4% achievement btw). I found it fun to figure things out and I do think the game has merit and is fun to play as it scratches an itch for me not found in other games. You can also revert back to the earlier versions - the dev added that functionality yet people still complain. I do think it's worth trying if you like this genre. I'll likely continue to play it. I do think it had better synergies before and some of those are broken in the current version or just not as bearable to play, but its still worth exploring. I like a good challenge.

I haven't played in a while, but came back to check it out and I'm honestly extremely disappointed with how different the game is. I'll try to summarize this as painlessly as possible: - Multiplayer got added, yay! But now you have to start a lobby to play single-player, huh? - The clarity of various effects has seen no improvement despite having very nice tooltips. This is worsened the further you get in a run. - There /was/ a system to alter your run - you could pick some extra damage, wisdom, etc. for your character - that has now been removed entirely. - Some characters still feel incredibly useless, so it doesn't feel like balancing has really been a focus for the game. It makes me question why so much has changed if not to make the game more balanced and enjoyable? Overall, I think this game was great, I loved the concept and the artwork. I don't think that the devs had the concept fully fleshed out, so they played with it, and they played too much. It has killed my enjoyment of the game and I cannot recommend purchasing it in it's current state.
